faqs.a: Meetings are held the third Tuesday of each month, 6:00 – 7:00 PM , in the Jefferson Elementary Library , 100 Princetown Rd., Schenectady. Use the Intermediate office entrance (the door in the bus lot). Can't make it in person? Meeting links are posted to our Facebook group before each meeting. Meeting details →
All Jefferson families and school staff are welcome.
Donate online to the Woestina Pre-K PTO or the Jefferson PTO , or see the Donate page .

faqs.a: See everything coming up on the Jefferson PTO page or the calendar .
Meet the team on the About page .

There are three meetings this school year, all on Thursdays from 6:00 – 7:00 PM at Schalmont Middle School , 2 Sabre Drive, Schenectady: Fall: Thursday, October 22, in the Middle School Band Room Winter: Thursday, January 14 Spring: Thursday, April 15 Join virtually on Google Meet , or dial (US) +1 724-259-7036, PIN 973 412 993#. Meeting details →
Meetings are open to all parents, guardians and school staff.
